fullPassage: Some movies are about current social issues that everyone is talking about. However, it is important to remember that not all films are meant to be topical. One reason is that it takes a long time to make a movie. Today's hot issues might not have existed when the script was being written. This is what happened with a movie that many people thought was about environmentalism. In some ways, this belief made sense. After all, the movie's plot concerned saving the Earth from pollution with a tiny plant. And when it was released, environmentalism was a big issue. But it simply wasn't true. In fact, the movie's writer and director came up with the idea for the plot nearly fifteen years before the film was completed and released. This was long before the current environmental movement had even begun.
